newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Energy cleared to restart uranium mill.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Energy cleared to restart uranium mill.

text.p: U.S. Energy Corp said Monday that its wholly-owned subsidiary Plateau Resources Ltd has been notified that the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission has issued a source material license to allow the resumption of operations at the Shootaring Canyon Uranium Mill.
The mill is in southeastern Utah.

The uranium stockpiles and uranium ores delineated in the nearby underground mines, which Plateau owns, will generate profits at present uranium prices well in excess of $10 million and additional profits from toll milling uranium owned by others in the area, the company said.
